description_excerpt: About the Role The Specialist, Production Delivery Management manages confirmed purchase orders from the Day-14 buy handover through to PO closure, keeping vendor commitments, WIP data and delivery dates reliable. The role maintains accurate order signals, identifies exceptions early and partners with Production Services and other relevant functions (such as GSP, GMP, Quality Operations, Materials Quality, Origin and Inbound Logistics) so delivery commitments remain visible, realistic and actionable.
